integrity.computational_role: The attached standard-library script checks rational algebra only; the proof is analytic.
integrity.proof_method: Exact support-radius inequalities and exact polynomial integration

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to support functions with only degree-three and degree-five axial Legendre modes.
The curvature constraints used are necessary samples; the theorem does not classify the entire feasible coefficient region.
No global volume-minimization claim over all constant-width bodies is made.
title: Exact two-mode axial constant-width volume bound
